entry.idea: Party and club organisers struggle to sell tickets and reach fans; Shotgun is an app and ticket service for events.
entry.lesson: Serve one lively niche better than the big general ticket sites.
entry.name: Shotgun

growth.basis: substitute: named in VivaTech Top 100 Rising European Startups 2026
growth.reason: No growth numbers in the dossier.

market.reason: A real market for events, but mostly nightlife and Europe.

tech.reason: Ticketing apps are solid engineering that can be copied in months.

entry.twist: It focuses on festive and nightlife events.
entry.who_pays: Event organisers pay fees on tickets sold; fans buy tickets.
entry.why_now: People want live events and phone ticketing is now normal.
